Good micro-interactions work as clues inside the app. Just the right duration creates perceived value. Subtle variation keeps the experience human, and response to user action makes the experience feel alive and memorable. All this communicated under 5s & the impact is hard to ignore. Think like a founding designer, playbook link attached.
